title: Recursively Testing and Vibe Debugging a Google AI Studio Generated Vibe-Coded Database Software Application
abstract: arXiv:2611.06952v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This research paper proposes a broader definition of vibe coding, extending the original one with non-developers and natural languages other than English, and introduces the notion of vibe debugging, as well as a sound, complete, and optimal algorithmic methodology for testing and vibe debugging vibe-coded software applications. This methodology is illustrated by applying it to a vibe-coded real-world database application of medium complexity generated with Google AI Studio Pro. We prove that even non-developers can obtain a final bug-free and functional satisfactory application version, even in languages other than English. We also prove that, although Google AI Studio Pro has sophisticated built-in engines for both language analysis, software development, and automated testing, it is still making lot of mistakes, so testing and vibe debugging of its generated code is a must.

translated_title: 对Google AI Studio生成的氛围编码数据库软件应用进行递归测试与氛围调试
translated_abstract: 这篇研究论文提出了氛围编程的更广泛定义，将原有定义扩展至非开发者以及英语以外的自然语言，并引入了氛围调试的概念，以及一种可靠、完备且最优的算法方法论，用于测试和氛围调试氛围编码的软件应用。该方法论通过应用于一个由Google AI Studio Pro生成的中等复杂度的真实世界氛围编码数据库应用来加以说明。我们证明了即使是非开发者也能获得最终无错误且功能令人满意的应用版本，即使使用英语以外的语言也是如此。我们还证明了，尽管Google AI Studio Pro拥有用于语言分析、软件开发和自动化测试的复杂内置引擎，它仍然会犯很多错误，因此对其生成的代码进行测试和氛围调试是必不可少的。
tldr: 该论文提出了扩展的氛围编程定义与氛围调试概念，并给出一种可靠、完备且最优的算法方法论，证明了即使是使用非英语语言的非开发者，也能通过递归测试与氛围调试将Google AI Studio生成的软件应用迭代至无错误且功能满意的版本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a broader definition of vibe coding and introduces vibe debugging, along with a sound, complete, and optimal algorithmic methodology, proving that even non-developers using non-English languages can recursively test and vibe debug a Google AI Studio-generated application into a bug-free, functionally satisfactory version.
